description: React component for displaying and managing an installed OAuth application, including secret handling, editing, and deletion.

classes.name: InstalledOAuthApp
classes.description: React component class for rendering an installed OAuth app with secret management and actions.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Checks if the OAuth app matches the provided filter string.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state with a fake secret.

methods.name: handleShowClientSecret
methods.description: Replaces the fake secret with the real client secret.

methods.name: handleHideClientSecret
methods.description: Reverts the client secret display to the fake secret.

methods.name: handleRegenerate
methods.description: Calls the regenerate secret function and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Triggers deletion of the OAuth app.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the OAuth app details, secret controls, and actions.
